summary: Public monitoring is now available in public preview for GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency (GHEC DR). Public monitoring with data residency Public monitoring extends secret scanning beyond internal repositories by monitoring public commits across github.com, attributing exposed credentials back to your enterprise in real time.
takeaways: Public monitoring with data residency Public monitoring extends secret scanning beyond internal repositories by monitoring public commits across github.com, attributing exposed credentials back to your enterprise in real time.
Because data residency environments maintain strict tenant isolation from github.com, enterprise membership rosters are not shared across the boundary.
Eligibility and billing Public monitoring is available in public preview for GitHub Enterprise Cloud customers with data residency.
